description: Planted single-series forecast twin of T1: linear trend + 12-month seasonality + AR(1) errors.
sizingNote: 240 monthly periods (20 years; Ruling Q9: >= 240 months), monthly rather than daily because the planted seasonality is 12-month and the real T1 twin (MoreCheese monthly attendance or dues) is monthly. Forecast scores use a rolling origin with K = 12 non-overlapping 12-month windows (144 scored forecasts, first origin after 96 training months), because a single 12-point test window measures RMSE with a relative SE of 0.396 while the 12 origins bring it to 0.114 (between-origin spread; evidence/logs/P2/recovery.txt). Paired per-origin comparison of a last-value naive forecast against the oracle OriginMean gives t = 5.31, so method differences of that size are detectable. The lag-1 autocorrelation SE is sqrt((1-phi^2)/n) = 0.052.
